env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd gomod
logos build -gcflags=-m .
stderr 'main\.go:4:2: moved to heap: x'
! stderr '^\{'

logos build -gcflags=-m --json-diagnostics .
stderr -count=1 '^\{.*"file":".*main\.go".*"message":"moved to heap: x"'
! stderr 'main\.go:4:2: moved to heap: x'

logos build -gcflags=-m .
stderr 'main\.go:4:2: moved to heap: x'
! stderr '^\{'

logos build -gcflags=-m --json-diagnostics .
stderr -count=1 '^\{.*"message":"moved to heap: x"'
cd ..

-- gomod/go.mod --
module example.com/gomod

go 1.27

-- gomod/main.go --
package main

func escape() *int {
	x := 1
	return &x
}

func main() {
	println(*escape())
}
